summary: Fence holder signals and pre-release cancellation by execution generation (unit 9c)

rules.detail: INACTIVE stop capability requires the same per-job generation serializer used for launch, release and recovery, retained through durable recording. No production caller or timing defaults.

compatibility.detail: Running-holder SIGTERM uses a pidfd acquired before identity and cgroup membership rechecks. Natural exit still retires the whole tree. Launching requires a live gate or retained proof of successful pre-release abort; retry repeats retirement without release.

manual.detail: Fake-fence and ignored native pidfd/gate fixtures added, including abort then retirement timeout then successful retry, and retry after retirement without durable recording. Cargo and native execution not run.

recovery.detail: A genuinely lost gate or mismatched generation is stop-uncertain. Successful pre-release abort remains a permanent no-release fence across cleanup or journal failures; it never permits relaunch.
